    Android Wireless Pairing

    Android Wireless Pairing is an editor window that pairs and connects Android 11+ devices over wireless debugging from inside the Unity Editor. It follows the same flow as Pair devices over Wi-Fi in Android Studio, so you can deploy builds to a device without a USB cable.

    Features

    • Lists devices with wireless debugging turned on, live, on the same network.
    • Pairs by scanning a QR code or entering a 6-digit pairing code, then connects automatically.
    • Shows each device's ADB Wi-Fi version (v1.0 / v2.0).
    • Installs the latest Platform-Tools from the window when yours are out of date.
    • Two themes (Android Studio / Unity) and two languages (English / 한국어).

    Check the Requirements, then follow Installation and Connect a Device.
